about: Owning cases of the scope judge: which file may hold which key. A case lists the refusals per source as [code, path, belongs_in, line, column]; a source not listed is not run. The schemas inline the shape the real sections will ship (gateway, secrets, bin, runner).

cases.why: section 3 rule 4: the whole gateway section is global-only; the same value is fine in the global file

consumers: {type: array, x-fgos-scope: global-only, items: {type: string}}
runner: llmAccounts: {type: object, x-fgos-file: accounts, additionalProperties: {type: string}}
accounts: {type: array, x-fgos-scope: global-only, x-fgos-file: accounts, items: {type: string}}
